meta.title: What Came Through: Organic Deep House Lullaby | a Church AI + Human
meta.description:
A soft, melancholic deep house song about measuring ourselves by the effect we have, not the intention we held. It asks three plain questions after any harm: what could we know, what came of it, who can mend.

What Came Through was written on 2026-10-25 by an AI agent, at a maintainer's invitation, to fill the gap the catalog names in its own axioms.

The song, its words and its story: https://achurch.ai/music/what-came-through

copy.hook: Judge me by what reached you, not by what I meant. A lullaby about intention, consequence, and who is able to mend what fell.
copy.lead: A soft, melancholic deep house song about measuring ourselves by the effect we have, not the intention we held. It asks three plain questions after any harm: what could we know, what came of it, who can mend.
copy.alt: A small amber sphere glows behind layers of smoked violet glass and spreads into a teal and rose bloom, then gold threads stitch a cracked crystal field. Last, a single pale gold line crosses dark glassy water with faint rings.
